ref_entities: run the mocap playback script to visualize motion capture data in the dm_control viewer
create a mocap playback environment with a CMU humanoid walker tracking motion capture reference data
launch the dm_control viewer with a persistent mocap playback environment loader
review the mocap_playback_env function to understand how it constructs the CMU humanoid tracking task
summarize the main function that constructs a persistent environment and launches the viewer
compute the bounded quaternion distance between source and target quaternions using bounded_quat_dist
compute squared differences between walker features and reference features using compute_squared_differences
run the termination reward function with a termination error and threshold using termination_reward_fn
run the multi-term pose reward function with walker and reference features using multi_term_pose_reward_fn
run the CoMic reward function combining termination and multi-term pose rewards using comic_reward_fn
test the rewards module compute_squared_differences function with walker and reference feature dictionaries
test compute_squared_differences with exclude_keys parameter to omit specific feature keys from results
test compute_squared_differences with quaternion features to verify bounded_quat_dist distance computation
run the RewardsTest absltest suite to validate all reward computation functions
review how bounded_quat_dist is used in EXPECTED_DIFFERENCES to compute quaternion distance squared
create a MultiClipMocapTracking task to train a walker to track mocap clips from a dataset
build a subclass of ReferencePosesTask to implement custom reference pose tracking logic for a new walker
create a PlaybackTask to visualize mocap reference data by replaying clips on a walker
refactor the _strip_reference_prefix utility to strip a given prefix from dictionary keys while preserving specified keep prefixes
review the get_all_reference_observations method to understand how reference joints, body positions, and quaternions are computed for the walker
test MultiClipMocapTracking task initialization and stepping with termination_reward or comic reward types
test MultiClipMocapTracking clip weight selection to verify correct clip is chosen on reset
test MultiClipMocapTracking task validation to ensure invalid ClipCollection arguments raise ValueError
test MultiClipMocapTracking prop factory to verify prop observations exist and match expected dimensions
test MultiClipMocapTracking ghost walker to confirm ghost offset does not introduce additional actions
create a grey ghost reference walker in a MuJoCo arena with no contacts or actuators
extract full qpos and qvel arrays from a dictionary of logged walker features
set a walker's freejoint and mocap joint positions and velocities in the physics model
set multiple prop positions and quaternions from a features dictionary with optional z offset
get a dictionary of walker features including position, quaternion, joints, velocity, and end effectors
